image_description: A lively outdoor scene featuring a traditional Maypole celebration. A tall, decorated pole stands in the center of a grassy field, adorned with long, colorful ribbons (pink, red, white) extending from the top. Numerous children and adults are holding the ends of these ribbons, dancing in a circle around the pole. The participants are dressed in casual summer clothing and some costumes. The background shows trees and a crowd of spectators.
